events.name: The Recursive Agents Hackathon
events.description: Build a team of agents you can walk away from. During the PyTorch Conference in
events.descriptionSummary: Teams of up to four will build persistent AI agents that plan, delegate, recover from errors, and operate with minimal oversight using Crusoe Managed Inference, NVIDIA infrastructure, and open models like Nemotron. Approved participants will compete for $25,000 in cash prizes and an NVIDIA RTX 5090.
